headline: Falcons sign DT Gervon Dexter Sr. to four-year extension
summary: The Falcons signed Gervon Dexter Sr. to a four-year, $78 million contract extension, sources told ESPN.

headline: Sean McVay: NFL told Rams DPI shouldn't have been called
summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay says the NFL told the team that defensive pass interference should not have been called against cornerback Josh Wallace in Sunday night's loss to the Broncos.

headline: Bears' Ben Johnson: 'Direction already made' on Week 4 QB call
summary: Bears coach Ben Johnson said he knows the "direction" the team will go at quarterback in Week 4 but won't publicly declare a starter.

headline: Giants' Harbaugh explains reasoning for releasing Beckham
summary: Giants coach John Harbaugh on Wednesday explained the team's decision for releasing wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr.

headline: Panthers CBs Jaycee Horn, Mike Jackson placed on IR
summary: The Panthers have placed starting cornerbacks Jaycee Horn (quad) and Mike Jackson (groin) on injured reserve after both were injured in the Week 3 loss to the Browns.

headline: Steelers head to Cleveland for matchup of 2-1 teams in Aaron Rodgers' final Thursday night game
summary: — Aaron Rodgers' NFL farewell tour continues with his final scheduled Thursday night game when the Pittsburgh Steelers face the Cleveland Browns.
